difficulty_reason: The lemma gives sufficient conditions for the completion of a module to be flat and for the completed ring to be Noetherian: the ideal is finitely generated, the quotient by it is Noetherian, the module modulo the ideal is flat, and the first Tor against the quotient vanishes. The proof first propagates flatness to the quotients modulo all powers of the ideal, using the standard criterion, then records that the completions are adically complete with the quotients by powers unchanged, quotes Noetherianity of the completed ring, and concludes flatness of the completed module from the flatness criterion for inverse limits of flat modules.
